arStrings.szText: {c_important}Ravens{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} increased damage and {c_important}Shapeshifting{/c} into a different form or activating a {c_important}Companion{/c} Skill {c_important}Summons{/c} a {c_important}Raven{/c} that attacks nearby enemies. {c_important}Summoning{/c} a {c_important}Raven{/c} has a chance to call forth an Unkindness for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, increasing the number of {c_important}Ravens{/c} {c_important}Summoned{/c} to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} for the duration.
